verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise page claims you can send meeting action items into Jira and Asana, and the integrations page claims action items can be sent to ClickUp. The Enterprise-only Public API also exposes action items programmatically, and the pricing page lists 'Otter API & Webhooks'. This support rests on one-line marketing claims: there is no documentation of an automatic per-meeting trigger, field mapping, or Linear support, and webhooks are only a pricing-page line item. missing for 10: documented native Jira/Asana/Linear integration setup and automatic per-meeting filing behavior, any Linear support, documented webhook events for action items, machine-readable API spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can automatically file each meeting's action items into my project tracker (Linear, Jira, Asana) using the product's API, webhooks, or native automations

citations.quote: Help your team move faster by sending actions items from meetings into tools they already use, like JIRA, Asana, and others.
Send meeting summaries and action items from Otter to ClickUp to manage everything in one place.
Otter's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details
Teams can automatically ingest meeting transcripts into internal knowledge bases or trigger actions based on meeting content
